parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: enterprise_project_id
parameters.description: Specifies the enterprise project ID. When creating a security group, associate the enterprise project ID with the security group.s.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies the security group name. The value is a string of 1 to 64 characters that can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: Specifies the resource ID of the VPC to which the security group belongs.

examples:
# create a security group
- name: Create a security group
  community.general.hwc_vpc_security_group:
    name: "ansible_network_security_group_test"

return_values.name: enterprise_project_id
return_values.description: Specifies the enterprise project ID. When creating a security group, associate the enterprise project ID with the security group. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Specifies the security group name. The value is a string of 1 to 64 characters that can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Returned: success

return_values.name: rules
return_values.description: Specifies the security group rule, which ensures that resources in the security group can communicate with one another. Returned: success

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Provides supplementary information about the security group rule. Returned: success

return_values.name: direction
return_values.description: Specifies the direction of access control. The value can be egress or ingress. Returned: success

return_values.name: ethertype
return_values.description: Specifies the IP protocol version. The value can be IPv4 or IPv6. Returned: success

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Specifies the security group rule ID. Returned: success

return_values.name: port_range_max
return_values.description: Specifies the end port number. The value ranges from 1 to 65535. If the protocol is not icmp, the value cannot be smaller than the port_range_min value. An empty value indicates all ports. Returned: success

return_values.name: port_range_min
return_values.description: Specifies the start port number. The value ranges from 1 to 65535. The value cannot be greater than the port_range_max value. An empty value indicates all ports. Returned: success

return_values.name: protocol
return_values.description: Specifies the protocol type. The value can be icmp, tcp, udp, or others. If the parameter is left blank, the security group supports all protocols. Returned: success

return_values.name: remote_address_group_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of remote IP address group. Returned: success

return_values.name: remote_group_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of the peer security group. Returned: success

return_values.name: remote_ip_prefix
return_values.description: Specifies the remote IP address. If the access control direction is set to egress, the parameter specifies the source IP address. If the access control direction is set to ingress, the parameter specifies the destination IP address. Returned: success

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: Specifies the resource ID of the VPC to which the security group belongs. Returned: success
